claim: Dragon Bridge fire-and-water show runs Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from 9:00–9:30 PM, free, with the dragon breathing fire first then spraying water; traffic on the bridge closes 15 minutes prior.
quote: from 9 to 9:30 PM on every Friday, Saturday and Sunday ... breathes bursts of flames several times from its mouth and then water ... Traffic on the bridge will be closed 15 minutes before

claim: In 2026 the Dragon Bridge Fire and Water Show continues on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights starting at 9:00 PM, with extra performances on Vietnamese public holidays.
quote: In 2026, the Dragon Bridge Fire and Water Show is held every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday night, starting at 9:00 PM

claim: The Han River Bridge is Vietnam's only operating swing bridge — a 487.7-metre cable-stayed span inaugurated 29 March 2000 that rotates about 90° around midnight and returns near 3 AM.
quote: often rotates in the midnight, approximately 90 degrees, and then returns around 3 am ... the only swing bridge that still rotates in Vietnam

claim: Thuan Phuoc Bridge is Vietnam's longest suspension bridge at nearly 2 km and is dramatically lit at night where the Han River meets the East Sea.
quote: nearly 2km long ... When the night falls on Han River, the Thuan Phuoc Bridge becomes more brilliant than ever under the colored lights

claim: The Museum of Cham Sculpture is open 7:30 AM–5:00 PM daily with a 60,000 VND adult ticket (free under 16) and houses the world's largest collection of Champa artifacts spanning the 5th–15th centuries.
quote: from 7:30 am to 5 pm every day ... 60,000 VND/adult ... houses the world's largest exhibition of Champa cultural artifacts

claim: The Cham Sculpture Museum holds several Vietnamese National Treasures and is the foremost institution for understanding Champa civilisation in central Vietnam.
quote: The Home of National Treasures

claim: Da Nang Cathedral (the Pink Church) is free to enter, open to tourists Mon–Sat roughly 8:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:30, and best photographed around 7:30–8:30 AM before the crowds.
quote: Monday to Saturday, roughly 8:00 AM – 11:30 AM and 1:30 PM – 4:30 PM ... Visit the cathedral around 7:30–8:30 AM to avoid crowds

claim: The cathedral is closed to sightseers on Sundays for masses and visitors are warned not to pay anyone claiming to sell entry tickets since admission is free.
quote: Da Nang Cathedral is free and open to the public. If you are asked to buy tickets online or at the church's entrance, it is likely that they are scammers

claim: Da Nang Downtown (formerly Asia Park / Sun World Da Nang Wonders), home of the Sun Wheel, permanently ceased operations on 3 September 2025 to make way for a 69-storey tourist development.
quote: Da Nang Downtown theme park to cease operations next month

claim: The Sun Wheel was a 115-metre Ferris wheel taking 17 minutes per rotation, operating 3 PM–10 PM, but the page now confirms it will close after 3 September 2025.
quote: 115 meters (377 ft) ... 17 minutes long ... Sun Wheel and Da Nang Downtown Theme Park will be closed after 3rd September 2025

claim: Han Market on Tran Phu Street operates 6:00 AM–7:00 PM daily and is best visited early; haggling 20–25% off marked prices is normal for clothing, coffee and souvenirs.
quote: open daily from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM ... discounts of 20-25% off

claim: TripAdvisor reviewers warn Han Market can feel cramped and smelly with pushy vendors despite being a useful spot to bargain for clothes and accessories.
quote: the smell of rotting salted fish, poor hygiene, no air conditioning

claim: My Khe Beach inside Da Nang stretches 8–9 km of clean white sand 15 minutes from the airport, is free to enter, and offers gentle swimming year-round with beginner surf May–July.
quote: 8–9 kilometers of fine white sand, gentle waves ... only 15 minutes from Da Nang International Airport

claim: Da Nang's official tourism portal cites My Khe among the ten most beautiful beaches in Asia, recognised by international media.
quote: My Khe beach, one of the ten most beautiful beaches in Asia

claim: Linh Ung Pagoda on the Son Tra Peninsula is free to enter, open 6 AM–9 PM, and is famous for Vietnam's tallest Lady Buddha statue at 67 metres overlooking the city coastline.
quote: the tallest statue of the Lady Buddha in Vietnam, which is 67 meters high

claim: The Lady Buddha statue contains 17 interior floors with 21 Buddha figures each and offers panoramic Da Nang views from the pagoda terrace 10 km from the city centre.
quote: Inside the statue is a 17-meter-wide area that includes 17 floors, and there are 21 Buddha statues on each floor

claim: Art in Paradise 3D Museum is a 4,000 m² indoor trick-art venue spanning nine themed zones with around 100 photo opportunities, popular as a rainy-day option.
quote: 4,000m² across two floors and features 9 themed zones

claim: Sky36 on the 36th floor of Novotel Danang Premier Han River is Da Nang's highest rooftop bar, offering a 360° view of the Han River and Dragon Bridge with smart-casual dress code.
quote: Sky36 Da Nang is located on the 36th floor of the Novotel Danang Premier Han River and is the highest rooftop bar in Da Nang

claim: Da Nang to Hoi An is approximately 30 km with a 40-50 minute drive by car or taxi, making it an easy day trip.
quote: The distance from Da Nang to Hoi An is approximately 30 kilometers (18.6 miles). The travel time from Da Nang to Hoi An is usually 40 to 50 minutes by car or taxi.

claim: Hoi An Ancient Town entrance ticket costs 120,000 VND per adult and admits visitors to 5 heritage sights.
quote: The Hoi An Old Town entrance ticket costs 120,000 VND per adult and children above 15 years old, and is free for younger children. Each ticket holder can visit 5 sights including museums, temples, and old houses.

claim: The Hoi An Lantern (Full Moon) Festival runs monthly on the 14th day of the lunar month with the ancient town closed to vehicles from roughly 6-10 PM.
quote: The Lantern Festival in Hoi An, also known as the Full Moon Festival, is a monthly event taking place on the 14th day of each lunar month... Each festival evening typically runs from around 6 PM to 10 PM, during which the ancient town center is closed to vehicles.

claim: Ba Na Hills 2026 standard adult ticket is 1,000,000 VND (~$39 USD) including round-trip cable car, Golden Bridge, French Village and Fantasy Park, with 1-3 day validity.
quote: Adults & children 130cm+: 1,000,000 VND (~$39 USD)... The ticket encompasses the cable car to go up Ba Na Hills and cable car to go down, plus access to Golden Hands Bridge, the French Village, and Fantasy Park.

claim: From 2026, Sun World Ba Na Hills cable car tickets are valid for up to three consecutive days allowing unlimited rides.
quote: From 2026, cable car tickets at Sun World Ba Na Hills will be valid for up to three consecutive days

claim: My Son Sanctuary entry is 150,000 VND for adults, opens 6 AM-5 PM, and sits ~40 km from Hoi An (~45 minutes), best visited early as a half-day trip.
quote: 150,000 VND for adults and 30,000 VND for children aged 5-15... Located approximately 40 km southwest of Hoi An and 45 minutes away by car from Hoi An... The guide describes this as an easy half-day trip.

claim: My Son tours from Da Nang take ~1.5 hours drive each way (1 hour from Hoi An), running 5-6 hours total from about $35 USD per person with guide and Cham dance show.
quote: My Son tours are available from $35 USD per person, including entrance fees, transfers, English-speaking guide, and bottled water. A standard My Son day tour from Da Nang or Hoi An lasts about 5–6 hours.

claim: Hai Van Pass Easy Rider one-day tours from Hoi An or Hue cost ~€50-52 and include guide, gas, helmet, with the 21 km pass dubbed one of the world's best coastal roads by Top Gear's 2008 Vietnam Special.
quote: Hoi An – Hai Van Pass – Hue (1 day): €52... The pass itself stretches approximately 21 kilometers, linking Da Nang and Lang Co, and reaches an altitude of 500 meters above sea level... best coastal roads in the world, as dubbed by Top Gear in their 2008 Vietnam Special.

claim: Hue is 92-110 km from Da Nang; the 6.28 km Hai Van Tunnel cuts driving time to 1.5-2.5 hours but excludes motorbikes, while the scenic pass takes 2.5-3+ hours by car.
quote: The distance between Hue and Da Nang is approximately 92 to 110 kilometers (57–68 miles)... The Hai Van Road Tunnel, with a length of 6,280m, significantly shortens travel time compared to going over the pass. However, this tunnel is only for cars and coaches; motorbikes are not allowed.

claim: Hue day-trip tours from Da Nang typically combine the UNESCO Imperial Citadel, Thien Mu Pagoda, and royal tombs with the Hai Van Pass viewpoint in one full day.
quote: Imperial Hue And Hai Van Pass Full-day Tour... The Citadel, which encompasses the Imperial City, the Forbidden Purple City, and the Emperor's Private Residence, built from 1804 to 1833 during the Nguyen Dynasty... Thien Mu Pagoda, Hue's largest pagoda built in 1601.

claim: Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son) entry is 40,000 VND, with an optional 15,000 VND one-way elevator and 20,000 VND for Am Phu Cave; site opens 7 AM-5:30 PM.
quote: The Marble Mountain entrance fee is 40,000 VND for adults and children above 10 years old, and is free for children below 10 years old... The elevator on the east side operates on a separate ticket: 15,000 VND one-way or 30,000 VND round-trip... To visit Am Phu Cave, visitors need to buy a separate ticket priced at 20,000 VND.

claim: Marble Mountains sit 20 minutes from central Da Nang and 40 minutes from Hoi An, work as a 2-3 hour half-day stop on the Da Nang-Hoi An road, featuring Huyen Khong Cave, Am Phu Hell Cave and panoramic viewpoints.
quote: 20 minutes from central Da Nang and around 40 minutes from Hoi An... Set aside 2-3 hours to explore the site properly... Huyen Khong Cave... Am Phu Cave: Known as the Hell Cave... Sweeping vistas of Da Nang City, My Khe Beach, and the East Sea.

claim: La Maison 1888 retained its one Michelin star in the 2025 Michelin Guide Vietnam, remaining Central Vietnam's only Michelin-starred restaurant and one of just nine one-star restaurants nationwide.
quote: La Maison 1888 successfully retained its one-star Michelin rating in the 2025 guide. It remains the sole establishment in Central Vietnam achieving this distinction, and one of only nine restaurants nationwide with a one-star designation.

claim: Dinner is served 18:30–21:00 daily with a smart-resort-wear dress code (no shorts; jacket not required) and a refundable VND 1,000,000-per-guest courtesy deposit at booking.
quote: Gentlemen are invited to wear smart resort wear (kindly no shorts please; jacket not required); dresses, smart skirts, or trousers are suggested for ladies... A courtesy deposit of VND 1,000,000/guest

claim: The restaurant is set inside a recreated French colonial mansion designed by Bill Bensley, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a black-and-white yin-yang palette, and themed private dining rooms.
quote: Bill Bensley created the space as 'a unique masterpiece' blending French Colonial style with Indochinese influences... a striking black and white palette, to symbolise the yin & yang of Asian wisdom

claim: The signature tasting menu features Chef Le Squer's haute-cuisine creations such as CROQUANT DE PAMPLEMOUSSE as part of an ever-evolving seasonal set menu.
quote: Vietnam's signature French restaurant and Central Vietnam's first Michelin Star with an ever-evolving seasonal menu by Michelin Chef Christian Le Squer

claim: Le Squer's signature Spaghetti Debout — meticulously upright pasta with black truffle, ham and tableside chanterelle cream — is among the celebratory dishes featured at La Maison 1888.
quote: Spaghetti Debout, features 'meticulously assembled pasta strands with indulgent black truffle and premium ham, crowned with a cream of golden chanterelles poured at the tableside.'

claim: Mì Quảng 1A is listed in the 2025 Michelin Guide Vietnam as a destination for Da Nang's signature turmeric-noodle dish with pork, shrimp, peanuts and rice crackers.
quote: Mì Quảng 1A is a restaurant in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide Vietnam

claim: Bún Chả Cá 109 holds a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Vietnam for its light, dill-and-tomato fishcake noodle soup — the city's other defining noodle bowl.
quote: Bún Chả Cá 109 is a Bib Gourmand: good quality, good value cooking restaurant in the 2024 MICHELIN Guide Vietnam

claim: Bánh Xèo Bà Dưỡng is a 30-plus-year-old alleyway shop celebrated by the Michelin Guide for crispy bánh xèo served with rice paper, herbs and grilled-pork skewers to roll at the table.
quote: This 30+-year-old no-frills shop at the very end of an alley serves a concise menu of crispy pancakes known as bánh xèo, alongside skewered pork, grilled meat and noodles.

claim: Madame Lân along the Han River offers a broad, polished Vietnamese menu in a recreated traditional-village courtyard — a popular first-night introduction for visitors.
quote: Madame Lân, set in a beautiful courtyard along the Han River mimicking a traditional Vietnamese village, is the perfect introduction for first-time visitors who want high-quality local food in a comfortable, clean, and beautiful setting.

claim: Bánh Mì Bà Lân, in business since 1990, is famous for skipping standard sauces in favour of Sa Huỳnh sea salt and pepper to enhance the fillings.
quote: Established in 1990, Banh Mi Ba Lan is a long-standing local eatery in Da Nang... it doesn't use traditional sauces but instead sprinkles a bit of Sa Huynh salt and pepper to enhance the refined flavor of the fillings.

claim: Vo Nguyen Giap Street fronting My Khe Beach concentrates Da Nang's seafood scene — Mỹ Hạnh (since 1991, in the 2024 Michelin Guide), Bé Mặn / Bé Bien, and Bib Gourmand pick Bé Nị 2 sit within a few blocks of each other.
quote: My Hanh Seafood was selected by the Michelin Guide in 2024. Address: No. 03-05 Vo Nguyen Giap Street... Be Ni 2... A Bib Gourmand pick in the 2024 Michelin Guide... Address: No. 228 Vo Nguyen Giap Street

claim: Helio Night Market on 2/9 Street in Hai Chau is the city's largest night-food complex, with hundreds of fixed-price stalls (10,000–35,000 VND) and a live-tank seafood section.
quote: Helio Night Market is considered the city's largest and most modern night market... Dishes have fixed prices, from only 10,000 to 35,000 VND

claim: Salt coffee (cà phê muối) originated around 2010 at a small Hue cafe and has since become a regional specialty served across Da Nang and Hoi An cafes.
quote: Salt coffee was created in Hue around 2010 by a couple — Mr. Phong and Mrs. Huong — at a small cafe on Nguyen Luong Bang Street... Salt coffee moved from Hue to Da Nang and Hoi An

claim: Linh Ung Pagoda sits on Son Tra Peninsula 693m above sea level, about 10km northeast of Da Nang city center.
quote: Linh Ung Pagoda is situated on Son Tra Peninsula, 639 meters above the sea level and 10 kilometers away from the center of Da Nang City to the northeast.

claim: My Khe Beach was the first place US troops officially landed in Vietnam in 1965 and the US Chief of Staff later made it an R&R center for soldiers based at the huge Da Nang facility.
quote: The American army stationed nearly 75,000 men in Da Nang... the US Chief of Staff decided to make this long white sandy paradise a 'rest & recuperation center' for US soldiers.

claim: The ABC TV series 'China Beach' (1988-1991) was set at an evacuation hospital on My Khe and cemented the wartime nickname in Western pop culture.
quote: China Beach is an American war drama television series set at an evacuation hospital during the Vietnam War... The series initially ran on ABC for four seasons from April 27, 1988, to July 22, 1991.

claim: Son Tra's red-shanked douc langur population — estimated by GreenViet at over 1,300 individuals — is the largest and most viable in the world for this critically endangered primate.
quote: According to the latest study by GreenViet organization, Son Tra is home to more than 1,300 individuals of the red-shanked douc langur, and this is the largest and most sustainable population of the species.

claim: Best douc-spotting window is the Feb-Aug dry season at sunrise, when blooming trees draw the langurs to feed near the road.
quote: The best time of the year is the dry season when it's sunny and no rains, from February to the end of August. In this period, many trees bloom, attracting langurs to come to eat or play.

claim: Three Son Tra loop routes reopened on 16 September 2025 after a nearly three-year closure from landslide damage: Tien Sa–Suoi Om–Ban Co Peak, Ban Co–Bai Bac, and Bai Bac–Heritage Banyan.
quote: Starting September 16, 2025, three freshly opened roads unlock the secret corridors of this peninsula wonderland... Tien Sa – Suoi Om – Ban Co Peak; Ban Co Peak – Bai Bac; and Bai Bac – Heritage Banyan Tree.

claim: Visiting hours are 7:30-18:30 (Mar-Sep) and 7:30-17:30 (Oct-Feb), with day-valid green cards issued to manage visitor flow and electric vehicles/bicycles encouraged.
quote: Visiting hours are from 7:30am–6:30pm (March to September) and 7:30am–5:30pm (October to February).

claim: Automatic scooters are banned beyond Son Tra checkpoints due to steep dangerous roads; only manual motorbikes, cars, taxis or tour vehicles can ascend, and military radar zones remain off-limits.
quote: Scooters and automatic bikes are banned beyond checkpoints due to steep, dangerous roads, with only manual motorbikes and tour vehicles allowed.

claim: Ban Co Peak sits at 630m and is reached by winding steps from Monkey Pass, offering panoramic views over Da Nang, the Cham Islands and the coast down to Hoi An.
quote: Ban Co Peak is accessed via a flight of winding steps up to a rocky summit with staggering views overlooking the jungled spine of Son Tra Peninsula, out to the East Sea where the Cham Islands look tiny.

claim: Bai Bac (North Beach) is a 600m private cove on Son Tra's northern edge that houses — and is essentially gated by — the InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort.
quote: As Bai Bac Beach is managed by and part of the InterContinental Da Nang Sun Peninsula Resort, direct public access is restricted. The most reliable and intended way to experience its beauty is to be a registered guest of the resort.

claim: Bai But (Buddha Beach) is a 300m fenced cove tied to a temple legend, and Bai Nam (South Beach) is an unspoiled 600m sand strip near the Lady Buddha statue with coconut groves and fishing boats.
quote: Bai But or the Buddha Beach is a pristine 300-meters-long beach. This beach is not opened yet to the public because it lies within a resort construction project.

claim: Non Nuoc Beach wraps the foot of the Marble Mountains ~8km southeast of central Da Nang and has been listed by Forbes among the world's most beautiful beaches.
quote: Non Nuoc Beach has an extraordinary beauty, with a winding sand stretch wrapped at the foot of the Marble Mountains. The beach was once listed by Forbes Magazine as one of the most beautiful beaches on the planet.

claim: Marble Mountains entry costs 40,000 VND (~$1.60) with an optional 15,000 VND elevator each way, and a full visit typically takes 2-3 hours.
quote: Entrance fee (Thuy Son Mountain): 40,000 VND (~$1.60) and elevator ride (optional): 15,000 VND one way (~$0.60).

claim: Cham Islands is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve marine park reached by ~20-minute speedboat from Cua Dai, with day tours combining sightseeing, snorkeling and a beachside Vietnamese lunch.
quote: Cham Islands is a famous archipelago, marine park and UNESCO world biosphere reserve near Da Nang. Day trips start at Cua Dai Beach to embark on a speedboat to Cham Island.

claim: Cham Island group day tours from Da Nang start around $34.56 per person, run 8-9 hours, and offer an optional paid scuba add-on requiring a dive certification.
quote: An 8-hour excursion from Da Nang or Hoi An to Cham Island costs from $34.56 per person... Guests can opt to add scuba diving for an additional fee.

claim: Easy Rider guided Hai Van Pass motorbike tours from Da Nang typically run 6-8 hours with pillion-passenger option and pickup in Da Nang/Hoi An/Hue, with listed prices around US$60-70 per person.
quote: Hai Van Pass Motorbike Tour with Easy Rider ... full day of adventure, scenic stops, and delicious local food.

claim: Only 1968 Vienna Convention IDPs are legally valid in Vietnam; 1949 Geneva IDPs (issued by US, UK, Australia, Canada) are not recognised, making self-ride on Hai Van Pass illegal for most Western tourists.
quote: International driving permits not issued under the 1968 Convention — for example, IDPs under the 1949 Geneva Convention — are not recognized and are considered invalid licenses when driving in Vietnam.

claim: Police checkpoints on Hai Van Pass increasingly fine unlicensed riders ~5 million VND (~€200) and can impound the bike 7-15 days; insurance is voided if you ride without a valid licence.
quote: There are several police check-points on popular routes (Ha Giang Loop; Hai Van Pass), where tourists are checked for a valid 1968-version of the international driver's license.

claim: Scooter rentals in Da Nang in 2025 cost roughly 80-150k VND/day (US$3-6) for a Honda Vision/Airblade and 150-200k VND/day for a Honda PCX; a tank of fuel runs 70-100k VND and lasts 3-5 days of city riding.
quote: Standard automatic scooters (Honda Vision/Lead/Airblade) cost 80,000-150,000 VND per day (about $3-6 USD), while premium scooters (Honda PCX, Yamaha NVX) are 150,000-200,000 VND per day.

claim: My Khe's surf season runs September-March, with the northeast monsoon producing the most consistent waves November-February; central beaches are essentially flat from late May through September.
quote: The Da Nang surf season usually runs from September to March, when consistent swells hit the central coast ... central beaches get mirror-flat from late May to September.

claim: The Ba Na Hills cable car holds the Guinness record for longest non-stop single-track cable car at 5,801 m, opened to the public 29 March 2013.
quote: The longest non-stop single track cable car is 5,801 m (19,032 ft) and was achieved by Ba Na Cable Car Service Joint Stock Company (Vietnam) in Bà Nà Hills, Da Nang, Vietnam.

claim: Son Tra Peninsula (Monkey Mountain) sits ~10 km northeast of central Da Nang, opens 7:30-17:30 (winter) / 18:30 (summer), and shelters >1,300 red-shanked doucs — the world's largest population.
quote: 2025 Opening Hours: 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM (Winter) or 6:30 PM (Summer) ... Son Tra is home to over 1,300 red-shanked doucs, making it the largest and most sustainable population in the world.

claim: Ba Na Hills Golf Club, 25 min from downtown Da Nang, is Luke Donald's only design — a par-72 championship course (not Nick Faldo, who designed Laguna Lang Co further north).
quote: The world-class Ba Na Hills Golf Club is the first and only design project of Luke Donald.

claim: Montgomerie Links is a Colin Montgomerie-designed links-style championship course between Da Nang and Hoi An, complementing the BRG Da Nang course and Ba Na Hills for a 3-course local circuit.
quote: Created by golfing legend Colin Montgomerie, Montgomerie Links Golf Club is truly an international 5-star championship links style course.

claim: Vietnam's only established canyoning is in Da Lat (Central Highlands), not Da Nang — typical tours combine abseils up to 25 m, a 100 m zipline and natural waterslides at Datanla waterfall.
quote: The typical tour includes three abseils (including an 18-meter dry cliff and a dramatic 25-meter waterfall), a 100-meter zipline through the forest canopy, two natural water slides.

claim: Dragon Bridge fire-and-water show runs Fri/Sat/Sun 9:00–9:15 PM in 2026, free to watch, with extra dates on national holidays.
quote: The Dragon Bridge Da Nang Fire and Water Show is held every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday night from 9:00 PM to 9:15 PM in 2026.

claim: Dragon Bridge breathes fire four times and sprays water three times in alternating intervals; visitors should arrive 30 minutes early for a good viewing spot.
quote: Dragon Bridge breathes fire four times and sprays water three times in alternating intervals. To avoid crowds and secure the best panoramic view, visitors should arrive at least 30 minutes early.

claim: DIFF 2026 official site: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival 2026 with theme 'Da Nang – United Horizons', 10 teams from nine countries.
quote: This year's edition carries the theme 'Da Nang – United Horizons' and brings together 10 teams from nine countries

claim: DIFF 2026 runs from May 30 to July 11 with six fireworks nights at the Han River Port area, starting around 8pm.
quote: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival 2026 runs from May 30 to July 11 with six nights of fireworks, street performances and riverfront festivities.

claim: DIFF 2026 night pairings: May 30 Vietnam Da Nang vs China; June 6 France vs Vietnam Z21; June 13 Japan vs Italy; June 20 Germany vs Macau; June 27 Australia vs Portugal; finale July 11.
quote: May 30 (Vietnam Da Nang vs China), June 6 (France vs Vietnam Z21 Vina Pyrotech), June 13 (Japan vs Italy), June 20 (Germany vs Macau), June 27 (Australia vs Portugal), and the final on July 11.

claim: In 2025 Sky36 features international DJs, LED-lit outdoor terraces with panoramic views of Han River, Dragon Bridge, and coastline, plus immersive light shows synced with live performances.
quote: Sky36 has kept its reputation by constantly updating its music lineups with international DJs and local talents. The LED-lit outdoor terraces provide panoramic views of the Han River, Dragon Bridge, and coastline.

claim: Helio Night Market typically operates 5:00 PM–10:30 PM with free entry, though some recent reports limit it to Fri–Sun.
quote: 5:00 PM – 10:30 PM daily

claim: Son Tra Night Market sits on Mai Hac De Street by the Han River, steps from Dragon Bridge — the closest night market to the old town/tourist core.
quote: The market sits right by the Han River, in one of the most walkable and scenic areas of Da Nang, and is steps from Dragon Bridge.

claim: Son Tra Night Market opens daily from 5:00 PM, peaking 7:00–10:00 PM, with weekend hours extending to midnight.
quote: Son Tra Night Market is open daily from 5:00 PM to midnight, with opening hours at 5:00 PM daily, closing around 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM on weekdays and extending until 12:00 AM

claim: Han River dinner cruises start at VND 130,000 basic, ~150,000 with dining and shows, up to VND 1.5M premium and VND 5M VIP during the DIFF festival.
quote: Prices range from 130,000 VND on a basic ticket to 1.5 million VND for a premium experience. … During the DIFF Festival (May to July), VIP packages can cost up to 5,000,000 VND per person.

claim: Major Han River cruise operators include Poseidon, My Xuan, Sweet Time, Tay Bac and Danang Dragon Cruise, with most evening departures starting around 18:00.
quote: Han River Cruise by Poseidon Cruise in Da Nang

claim: Sun World Asia Park (Da Nang Downtown) is open 15:00–22:00; Sun Wheel single ride VND 150,000 adult, with an all-in-one ticket at VND 250,000 — best ridden at sunset/evening.
quote: The Sun Wheel ticket price is 150,000 VND for adults and children above 1.4 meters high

claim: The An Thuong 'Western Quarter' near My Khe Beach is Da Nang's main expat bar/restaurant strip, with international food stalls and weekend live music.
quote: An Thuong Walking Street & Food Court, nicknamed the 'Western Quarter' of Da Nang, lies near My Khe Beach and is a haven for international cultural exploration.

claim: Brilliant Top Bar on the 17th floor of Brilliant Hotel hosts live music every Saturday and holidays, with Latin Nights and Jazz Evenings featuring local bands.
quote: Brilliant Top Bar is the venue for regular activities of Brilliant Hotel with Live Music every Saturday and holidays.

claim: OQ Lounge Pub at 18-20 Bach Dang Street, Hai Chau is a riverside club with the slogan 'drink not drunk', staffed by professional bartenders and DJs.
quote: Location: 18-20 Bach Dang Street, Hai Chau District, Da Nang.

claim: Da Nang has a modest kayaking scene listed on TripAdvisor (e.g. Kayak Splash and Dash Fun Session) but no major commercial paddling hub — Cham Islands and Hoi An waterways are the principal water-tour focus for the area.
quote: THE 10 BEST Da Nang Kayaking & Canoeing Activities (2026)
